hero.intro: This project deals with the smart watering of trees in an urban context. Sensor-based monitoring transmits and evaluates data via the LoRaWAN network, so that watering recommendations can be issued. Based on these recommendations, watering plans for a watering tour can be created.

keyFacts.heading: What exactly does Green Ecolution help you with?
keyFacts.interpretation: Interpreting sensor measurement data with a traffic-light system
keyFacts.routing: Dynamic route planning for watering trips

quickLinks.heading: Views for efficient watering monitoring
quickLinks.intro: Our system offers various views for monitoring the watering status of the trees. You can display all trees on a map, view the installed sensors with battery level and readings, and pull up an overview of past and upcoming watering trips.

map.description: Show all watering groups & trees on the map
map.headline: Map including the location of all trees

sensors.description: Shows all installed sensors incl. battery level, readings, …
sensors.headline: List of all installed sensors

wateringPlans.description: List view of all watering plans that are planned, completed, active etc.
wateringPlans.headline: Overview of watering plans & route planning

sensorSolution.label: Development of a sensor solution
sensorSolution.description: Soil moisture data is delivered using sensors placed at different depths.

dataEvaluation.label: Evaluation of measurement data
dataEvaluation.description: Evaluation of the data transmitted by sensors for needs-based watering of trees.

youngTrees.label: Focus on young trees
youngTrees.description: Young trees are especially vulnerable to heat and therefore need particular protection. For this reason, trees are monitored during their first three years in the ground.

multiSite.label: Monitoring multiple sites
multiSite.description: Using the LoRaWAN network, different sites can be monitored and additional ones easily added.

planning.label: Simplified watering plan scheduling
planning.description: Watering trips can be planned digitally and quickly. Information such as staff as well as vehicles used and their water capacity can be recorded.

routing.label: Dynamic route planning
routing.description: Dynamic calculation of watering routes using open-source software (Valhalla & Vroom).
